source_refs.note: Step 2: Annealing of Primer: a main subheading of 20.3.1 Steps of PCR, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 160-160.

blocks.text: Ab mehlool (solution) ko taqreeban 60°C tak thanda hone diya jata hai. Thanda hote hue forward aur backward primers single-stranded DNA par apni complementary (jor wali) jagahon se jur jate hain (anneal ya hybridize hote hain). Baqi tukra single-stranded hi rehta hai.
